Generate initial values for semifield model

generate_inits_semifield.Rd

Creates random initial values for MCMC chains for the semifield model. The semifield model uses continuous-time Markov chains for time-to-event data.

Usage

generate_inits_semifield(n)

Arguments

n

Number of experiments (replicates). Used to size hierarchical random effects.

Value

A function that generates a named list of initial values:

  • HostAvailabilityReduction: Reduction in host availability (pi in the article)

  • KillingDuringHostSeeking: Killing/disarming during host seeking (kappa in the article)

  • a, m: Log-scale baseline rates

  • sigma_a, sigma_m: Hierarchical SDs

  • phi, psi: Experiment-level random effects (n)

Details

The semifield model estimates, per night:

  • alpha_H: Rate of host-seeking success

  • mu: Mortality rate

The intervention effects are modeled as alpha_H1 = (1 - HostAvailabilityReduction) * alpha_H0 and mu1 = mu0 + KillingDuringHostSeeking * alpha_H0.

See also

generate_inits_basic, fit_ento_model
